title: A change list that is not valid JSON keeps its valid edits; a whole document is read as before
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A change list that is not valid JSON keeps its valid edits; a whole document is read as before.

tests: a valid change list is read as it always was, with nothing marked repaired
one broken edit in the middle of a list costs only that edit
a list cut off in the middle keeps its whole edits; brackets and quotes inside values never end an edit
a whole document that is not JSON, two lists, or a list with no whole edit stay unread
